english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something added beyond what was originally included, such as an additional charge.
For ordinary additional work, pay, time, or items, 額外 is the all-purpose choice; it does not imply that they are unnecessary.
Use this for something additional or beyond what has already been mentioned.

examples.english: This card has an additional five-dollar charge.
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 kaat1 jiu3 ngaak6 ngoi6 sau1 ng5 man1

examples.english: I have to work overtime this month, so I get extra pay.
examples.traditional: 我今個月要加班，所以有額外工資。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 jiu3 gaa1 baan1 so2 ji5 jau5 ngaak6 ngoi6 gung1 zi1

examples.english: This time, there will be a further charge.
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jiu3 sau1 ngaak6 ngoi6 fai3 jung6
